b: Grav jumps follow mapped lanes, not straight lines.
text: You can't point your ship at a star and go — the route has to exist first.

b: Oxygen kills faster than damage does.
text: Extreme heat, cold and low pressure drain it before you've noticed you're in trouble. Check the planet's stats before you get out and admire the view.

b: Don't fly into a city hot.
text: Contraband scanners at the gates mean anything you're smuggling gets found before you do anything with it.

b: Your scanner is doing more than you think.
text: Surveying, resources, outposts — most of the economy runs through the same tool on your wrist.

b: Companions have opinions, and they will share them.
text: Whoever you bring along is watching what you do, not just what you say.

b: Cruise Mode is worth getting used to.
text: Since Free Lanes, it lets you walk your ship's corridors while covering the distance a loading screen used to hide. Slower, but you stop missing things.

b: Keep an eye on your Incursion Chance setting.
text: If Terran Armada turning your favourite outpost into a firefight sounds fun, turn it up. If it doesn't, turn it down — it's in Gameplay Options.

b: A towel remains, whatever the century, about the most massively useful thing a traveller can carry.
text: This guide cannot get you one. That's on you.
